current.sourceState: 08.00 working tree; source file hashes identify measured implementation

protocol.comparison: Compare baseline normal to current normal. Current aggregate pools four distinct skills and is not a same-skill comparator.
protocol.trajectories: Frozen07.00 physical Movement; stationary, alternating .65s strafe, continuous crouch, manually pressed jumps every .85s.
protocol.conditions: Single stationary defender at20m; no walls, sounds, return fire, targetrandomization or reposition. Exposurelimit disabled. Default baseline settings and newskillprofiles. This probe measures deterministic game behavior, not human fairness.
protocol.settings: Old default reaction0.35s/new default0.42s; otherwise production defaults with no exposurelimit, targetSpeed0, reposition0, randomDefendersfalse. One stationary defender at20m. Newskillprofiles use default independentcontrol values.
protocol.timingFields: DefenderShot.reactionTime is detection-to-aim-start, including recognition and reaction delay. aimAcquisitionTime is aim-start-to-emission and includes follow-up time; first-shot medians are separately recorded.
protocol.aimError: controlledAngularError compares finite motor orientation against its delayed observed aim. trajectoryAngularError compares actual emitted ray including recoil/spread to delayed desired direction.
protocol.cpu: Elapsed single-process Vitest CPU wallclock. Different death times cause different active tick counts. Per-tick numbers are directional single-defender serverCPU probes, not a renderer or scalability benchmark.

limits.fairnessConclusion: No human fairness guarantee. These are seeded deterministic physical-ray encounters without player returnfire, cover, emitted sounds or tactical reposition.
limits.survivalInterpretation: 8s open exposure with no returnfire is deliberately lethal, not an expected player encounter. Earlier survival horizons are also reported.
limits.sampling: 16held-out seeds ×4weapons ×4physical playerposes; four newskill profiles. Synthetic trajectories are frozen07.00 movement to isolate combat implementation changes.

baseline.method: Same-host sequential clean gameplay-canvas render benchmark. Paused-only runs isolate rendering; actual AI CPU cost is measured separately. 1366x768, Low preset, renderScale0.5, no pause-overlay blur, Vandal, 10rAF warmup, 60rAF samples. SoftwareGPU is not player hardware. Development Vite load timing is not CDN asset latency. GPU utilization and physical input latency unavailable.

limits.comparison: Only paired paused garage scenes can be compared. New-map scenes have no baseline equivalent. This is a single sequential software-GPU probe, not evidence of hardware gameplay FPS, input latency or native game performance.
limits.memory: Accessible JS heap is a point sample and may include cached modules or prior allocations; GPU memory consumption is unavailable.
limits.assetLoad: Development-server navigation/resource timing is reported; not production-CDN asset timing.

browserQA.transport: Local development Vite over loopback; actual Chromium WebGL and React UI

limits.fullscreen: Document fullscreen API entered via actual trusted Playwright buttonclick; viewport sizes recorded from browser

contrast.method: Computed styles in the actual React development application; WCAG sRGB contrast for opaque design-token pairs and rendered primary controls. No claim of a complete WCAG audit.
